title: mcp: the data tools answer an undeclared sandboxed hook abort with no code and the sandbox wrapper text, where /data answers 400 HOOK_ABORTED
body:
domain:devx#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5njkh3xbcDN6EtSfw7

Filing-gate class **b** (door parity, measured). Found by the #31145 card thread while tracing the scenario runner's "(tool error without a code)" on leave_balances `submit_over_balance`; reported in its os-dev report (comment 6711051465 on #31145), out of that card's scope (a scenario-runner card fixes no platform package).

## Reproduction (measured on `MCPServerRuntime`, no booted stack)

- HTTP `/mcp` `update_record` with a data bridge that throws the QuickJS sandbox's error shape for an undeclared hook abort answered:
  `{content:[{type:"text",text:"hook 'demoleave_leave_request_guard' threw: Error: Not enough annual leave remaining"}],isError:true}`
  There is no `ErrorCode`, and the text is the sandbox's debug wrapper (hook name included).
- `mapDataError` on the same error (`packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts`, seam `UNDECLARED_HOOK_REFUSAL_CODE`) answers `400 HOOK_ABORTED` with the inner sentence only. So `/api/v1/data` and the MCP data tools disagree on the same refusal.
- Cause read in code: `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` `errorResultWithCode` → `thrownRefusalEnvelope` reads only `err.code`, so the undeclared-abort classification that the REST door applies never runs at the MCP door.

## Same family (read in code, not measured)
- A code hook's bare throw: MCP uncoded vs REST `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`.
- The runtime `callData` throw `{statusCode:503,message}`.

## Ask
Make the MCP data tools classify a thrown error the way the data door does (one shared seam, not a second copy), so an undeclared hook abort answers `HOOK_ABORTED` with the inner sentence and no sandbox wrapper. Cover the family members above or state why each differs. Pin with a test at the MCP door. Clause-② and changeset readings belong to whoever claims it.

## NOT MEASURED
- A booted stack.
- Which throw the leave_balances run actually hit (no recording).

Prior art, all closed: #27508 / #27597 (HOOK_ABORTED at the data door), #27672 (doors resolving through `resolveThrownHttpError`), #29978 (import door parity), #23509 (MCP rendered a coded refusal as message only).
